confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from 2026 travel guides and crowd-sourced aggregators (Numbeo, Expatistan), mostly undated or with small samples, so they are bounded estimates. Wine by the glass had no direct Tokyo source and is set relative to the beer anchor. Hotel and hostel anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not checked against live listings. Yen figures were converted at an approximate 2026 rate. The FX observation came from a search summary of the RBA data and was not verified by opening the RBA table.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was used. Food and drink anchors are based on Tokyo-specific 2026 price references, converted from yen. Accommodation anchors reflect general knowledge of typical Tokyo hostel, basic hotel and three-star hotel rates.
